name: Ahijah
summary: A prophet from Shiloh who told Jeroboam that he would rule ten tribes of Israel. Years later, old and blind, he told Jeroboam's wife of the judgment coming on their house.

key_moments.title: The Torn Garment
key_moments.description: Ahijah met Jeroboam alone in a field outside Jerusalem and tore a new garment into twelve pieces. He told Jeroboam to take ten, for the LORD would tear the kingdom out of Solomon's hand.

key_moments.title: A Blind Prophet Sees
key_moments.description: Ahijah's eyes had grown dim with age, but the LORD told him Jeroboam's wife was coming in disguise. He greeted her as the wife of Jeroboam when she came in, and told her that her sick son would die.
